result.result_summary: Centering plus renormalisation is not interchangeable with the shipped all_but_the_top(k=1) on the conditioned selection axis. On the 10 ibm triples {document, anchor, source} (pool 81 to 93 statements, OpenVINO INT8) DR(D_sel) reads raw 0.034535, shipped 0.219067 (6.3433x raw), arm a 0.119861 (0.5471x shipped), and arm a reads 1/28 violations (haiku 0.140584 >= adv2-b 0.136424) against 0/28 shipped; per document D_sel under arm a is 0.330 to 0.502 times the shipped value and Spearman with shipped is 0.9758. Decision rule: ACC-GEOM-21 does not change the conditioned-path pre-pass. The cause differs from the registered mechanism: the shipped reader (markdown=False) segments the ibm source into 70 statements of which 22 are one word ('-' 13 times, '###' 6 times, '##' twice, 'Overview' once); the centered PC1 of every triple carries a share of 0.6835 to 0.6921 of the variance and separates those 22 (coordinate +0.709 to +0.868) from every document statement (-0.443 to -0.230); cos(centered PC1, mean direction) is 0.2499 to 0.3091, not 0.056. Centering alone leaves the prose source statements close to each other (mean ground cost 1.1608 against 1.4110 shipped). Readings without a bar, added after the first execution: arm a / shipped reads 0.9165 at 0/28 violations with the 22 one-word source statements removed (48 left) and 1.7248 at 0/28 with the 28 statements of fewer than 5 words removed (42 left), where the shipped DR falls to 0.152500 against 0.263025 under arm a; with the E04 pool (all 11 summaries plus the source, 168 statements) arm a reads 0.9359x at 0/28; on the Wergeland source with its three sections D_sel under arm a is 0.930 to 0.944 times the shipped value with the order of the three triples preserved.
result.caveats: (1) One source and one anchor: 10 documents, 6 gold and 4 adversarial. The violation is one ordering, by 0.004160; the DR clause alone (0.5471 below 0.9) gives Confirmed. (2) The registered mechanism is not what the outputs show: the projection removes the component of 22 one-word markup statements that the shipped reader produces from the ibm source, not content of the source. The comparison of the two pre-passes depends on which short statements the source holds: arm a / shipped reads 0.5471, 0.9165 and 1.7248 on the registered source, with statements of fewer than 2 words removed and with statements of fewer than 5 words removed. The bar is one-sided (below 0.9x) and does not count 1.7248 as a difference. (3) The section on the first principal component (inventory, ground cost, two counterfactuals) is not in the registered record and has no bar; it was added after the first execution showed the PC1 share, and its two word rules (an executor's rule) were chosen with those outputs in view; no kill-gate, bar or verdict field reads them. The counterfactuals remove rows from the encoded source and do not re-segment with markdown=True. (4) Executor's rules stated in the configuration cell where the record is open: argument order a = document (the record names the pool {document, anchor, source}; baseline.py and E14-H75 use a = anchor, and that order gives the same readings); the harness rule; the metric-property tolerances (the E12-H64 reading: float64, exact-unit copies). (5) The E04 violations definition runs over 28 orderings because its gold_labels list holds the anchor; the count over the 24 orderings without the anchor is the same number in every arm. (6) Repeated source statements make the lowest ground cost 0.0000 in every arm, so D_sel reads 0 between two coverage profiles that differ only between repeated statements; no arm changes that. Under the shipped arm the closeness of adv2-a is clipped to 0 (residual 1.4150). (7) Wergeland: three triples, no tiers; the shipped reader turns the HTML provenance comment and the heading lines into source statements (52 statements, 3 of one word); the standard deviation over three D_sel values (arm a / shipped 0.6448) is not a dynamic-range reading. (8) The notebook was executed more than once while it was built; every execution of the measurement cells read the same numbers (the metrics file of the last two executions is byte-identical). Autoreload is off so that one fixed copy of the shipped code is scored; the two ASCII arrows in the notebook are inside the verbatim E04 code quote.
